title: Video RE parameteriser
summary: Subagent that turns a lifted IR into a reusable format: typed parameters with evidence-justified ranges, procedural generation rules, a reproduction check and a short_video_spec render binding.
description: Generalises concrete observations (for example 4 items of about 12 s) into parameters (n_items with a derived range) and rules (item_s = (target_duration_s - intro_s - outro_s) / n_items), checks that the rules reproduce the source when parameters take observed values, and marks every range wider than the evidence as assumed. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

side_effects: rewrites format_ir.json and writes parameterise_report.json in the output directory
